goal: Make each requirement checklist row a single accessible checkbox control: tapping its label or row toggles the requirement once; screen readers hear its existing label and format together with checked/disabled state.
acceptance_criteria: Use the Compose toggleable row pattern with Role.Checkbox; checkbox onCheckedChange should be null so the row owns the event.
Associate visible label/format with the row for accessibility. Preserve a minimum 48dp touch target and current layout/Arabic wording.
Derive checked state from operation.checkedRequirementIds and preserve disabled state when operation.status is COMPLETED.
Call model.toggleRequirement(requirement.id) exactly once per activation.
Preserve pager, dependency logic, completion gates, overview, simulations and sources. No ViewModel/domain/data/build edits.
No tests or unrelated changes. Return only small exact-substring edits and necessary imports. Do not claim runtime verification.
